integrity: Finite exhaustive self-contained standard-library checker included; the graph and all algebraic actions are precisely defined. Exact citations and acknowledged literature-access risks. No independent audit, formal proof certification, or third-party validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for fully labeled 5 by 5 Latin squares, with intercalate flips as the sole moves; no claim about mixing times, other orders, or an elementary parity-free formula for the components. The older Wanless (November 2004) comparison source has month-resolved but not day-resolved public dating and is not asserted to have an invented exact publication day. The 2011 source was available only by publisher abstract; its full text was not inspected, and unindexed earlier tables remain possible.
title: Labeled \(5\times5\) Latin-square intercalate graph: eight equal components of diameter \(13\)
